name: bare-blake3
description: BLAKE3, compiled, for Bare (iPhone, Android, Mac), and a stand-in for hash-wasm that uses it. An iPhone app's JavaScript has no compiler and no WebAssembly, so pearcore's BLAKE3 fell back to plain JavaScript at about 2 MB a second; with this it runs at about 2,000.

scripts.test: bare test.js && bare test-stand-in.mjs && bare test-stand-in.mjs skip=compiled && node test-stand-in.mjs && node test-stand-in.mjs skip=wasm
